notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Prepared Defenses, and the three Effects Mobilization Points, Secret Plans and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60.

The deck is built without Reflections III cards ('No R3'); Secret Plans and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement are the pre-Reflections III Effects (Special Edition and Reflections II), not the Defensive Shields.

Posted 'Corporal Delosyn' dested Corporal Drelosyn; 'Tatooine Docking Bay 94' and 'Tatooine Mos Espa Docking Bay' dested the Dark sites; 'Boba Fett In Slave One' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Ability, Abilty, Ability' dested Ability, Ability, Ability; 'We Must Accellerate Our Plans' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans.
